title: A/P Detail: switching location in the top right reloads the report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, your current location and location B.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations, so you can switch to location B in the location switcher.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A, with an overdue bill A at location B and others at your current location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with vendor A ticked, "Past due: 1-30 days" ticked, the "Amount" header clicked once, every group expanded and the page scrolled down.
custom_steps:
1. Open the location switcher in the top right of ShopView.
  2. Switch to location B.
  3. Click bill A's number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The location switcher opens.

Step 2:

  • The report reloads and you stay on it, with the same filters (the same as-of date, vendor A ticked, "Past due: 1-30 days" and every location ticked) and the same rows, back in the opening order (the Amount sort is gone).
  • Every group is collapsed and the page is back at the top.

Step 3:

  • It is now a link and its delivery opens (before the switch it was plain text, because it was at another location).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S5-E2: “Switching location in the top right of ShopView while on a report reloads it, as on every other report: the user stays on the report with the same filters and the same rows; the sort returns to the opening order (Story 1), every group collapses and the page returns to the top; which documents link, prompt or show as plain text updates (Story 7).”
  • Out of Scope: “The location switcher in the top right of ShopView. It is not changed. Switching location while on one of these reports reloads it, as on every other report: the filters and the rows stay, because the reports are organization-wide; the sort returns to the opening order, groups collapse and the page returns to the top; which documents link, prompt or show as plain text updates (Story 7).”
  • S7-E1: “The location switcher in the top right of ShopView is not changed.”
